scope: Preserve VmRequester shared-memory offset-to-region-id ownership until an explicit unregister request succeeds
notes: The existing &mut self method serializes access to its own map; region id implements Copy.
vm_control already retains RegisteredMemory on release/reclaim failure. Keeping this mapper id preserves a later explicit caller retry.
An operation may fail after the peer completes it or during transport. This patch preserves existing error reporting; it does not establish remote release state or add an automatic retry.
Actual-method host tests use a fake unregister client. They do not execute IPC, Gunyah, GPU, a whole VMM build or physical devices.
This is a correctness fix for failed unregister ownership; current two-window ENOSPC cause is not proven to involve an unregister failure.

scenarios: unregister fails first then succeeds on explicit caller retry, preserving exact original id
success removes offset once and preserves other mappings
three failures preserve ownership with exactly one request per call
host_validation.scope: Actual extracted source method with a mock IPC client and Context error adapter; no reimplementation of the method, IPC or kernel/driver execution
